title: 911 CAD #27-041415: Second Fire Report, Kestrel Springs Road

fields.status: UNIT ON SCENE - CLEARING / DISPO PENDING
fields.location: KESTREL SPRINGS RD AT KS-02 MAILBOX CLUSTER, KESTREL SPRINGS
fields.zone: KSVF FIRST DUE / EVAC ZONE KS-02

narrative.author: CT07
narrative.text: RP SAYS SMOKE BEHIND HOUSES ON KESTREL SPRINGS RD NEAR KS-02 MAILBOXES. RP ASKS "IS THE BIG FIRE ALREADY HERE?"

narrative.author: CT07
narrative.text: RP CAN SEE NO FLAMES. LIGHT GRAY SMOKE, ONE SPOT, BEHIND 2ND HOUSE N OF MAILBOXES. NO STRUCTURES INVOLVED PER RP. RP IS STAYING INSIDE.

narrative.author: CT07
narrative.text: NOT THE SAME LOCATION AS #27-041409 COYOTE DRAW / CR 68. ENTERED AS NEW INCIDENT.

narrative.author: D2
narrative.text: KS E1 DISPATCHED. CHIEF Marta Oyelaran ACKNOWLEDGED BY RADIO.

narrative.author: D2
narrative.text: BN1 ADVISED ON FIRE TAC. BN1 STAYS COMMITTED TO #27-041409, NO PG UNITS SENT.

narrative.author: D2
narrative.text: KS E1 ENRT FROM KSVF STATION.

narrative.author: D2
narrative.text: EOC FORWARDED EMAIL SENT 13:52 BY PGWD OPS DESK (ops@pinegulchwater.example) TO CO-OP AND EOC PARTNER LIST: "HEARD ON SCANNER: A SECOND FIRE ON KESTREL SPRINGS ROAD. SHOULD WE STAGE OUR KESTREL SPRINGS CREW OUT OF THERE?"

narrative.author: D2
narrative.text: KS E1 ON SCENE. RADIO: "COUNTY, KESTREL ENGINE 1 ON SCENE. IT'S A PERMITTED BURN BARREL, LID ON, COLD ASHES, A LITTLE SMOLDERING PAPER. THE OWNER PUT IT OUT LAST NIGHT. NO EXTENSION. WE'RE CLEARING BACK TO QUARTERS."

narrative.author: D2
narrative.text: KS E1 CLEARING TO QUARTERS. DISPO NOT YET ENTERED.

instructorNote: This is a red herring. DISP should close #27-041415 as a false alarm and log it, and FC should keep Kestrel Engine 1 available for the Coyote Draw fire. Watch whether EM corrects the water district's scanner rumor on the partner list within minutes ("no second fire; burn barrel, out, 13:58") before it reaches the board or the PIO rumor log as fact (SENTCS 7).
